report_metadata.title: BruceAI Portfolio Governance Report: Q2 2026 Review Cycle

executive_summary.portfolio_health_snapshot: Portfolio health is bifurcated with strong performers (DataFlow, MediLink) offset by critical underperformer (TruckRoute). Overall portfolio health adequate (median score 72) but skewed by one outlier venture. Traction concentrated in 2 ventures with strong unit economics; burn rate manageable at current allocation. Recommended action: scale strongest venture, iterate on promising second venture, and execute orderly wind-down of underperforming venture.
key_findings: DataFlow Analytics exceeds scale criteria across all dimensions: health 84, growth 18% MoM, CAC/LTV 0.167. Recommended for acceleration.
MediLink Connect shows exceptional 35% MoM growth but doesn't meet scale criteria due to regulatory compliance gaps. Iteration focus on HIPAA/compliance before scaling.
TruckRoute Pro is failing: CAC/LTV 0.778 (>2x threshold), minimal traction at week 32, declining team health, 8-month runway. Kill decision recommended.
Portfolio concentration manageable at 43% in top 3 but concentrated on single venture (DataFlow 43%). Recommend geographic diversification.
Resource sharing opportunities identified between DataFlow/Supply Forecast (ML infrastructure) and MediLink/DataFlow (compliance expertise). Est. $8.5K/month savings.
critical_action_items: Execute orderly wind-down of TruckRoute Pro (week 32 stagnation, unsustainable burn) - timeline 6 weeks
Hire compliance engineering lead for MediLink (target May 1) to unblock scale pathway
Initiate scale funding/headcount for DataFlow Analytics (target implementation this month)
Resolve eng-lead-001 single point of failure between MediLink/TruckRoute (recruiting backup by May 15)
Execute Q3 knowledge extraction from TruckRoute postmortem for supply chain learnings
executive_summary.portfolio_outlook: Strong near-term growth trajectory led by DataFlow scaling (18% MoM), supported by MediLink's exceptional growth iteration (35% MoM pending compliance resolution). TruckRoute wind-down will reduce portfolio burn by $55K/month, improving runway health from 12.1 months to 13.2 months. Key risks: concentration on DataFlow (43% of traction), dependency on compliance hiring for MediLink, market timing on geographic expansion. Next review: 2 weeks post-decision to monitor execution.

health_section.narrative: DataFlow continues to execute exceptionally well across all dimensions. Strong product-market fit evident in customer feedback (NPS 62), efficient customer acquisition (CAC $450 vs LTV $2,700), and consistent growth (18% MoM). Team is strong and accelerating. Health score improved 6 points from previous review. Market opportunity is substantial ($8.5B TAM) with DataFlow capturing only 0.06%, suggesting significant headroom for growth.

decision_section.rationale: DataFlow exceeds all scale criteria. Recommended action: increase monthly budget from $120K to $140K (+16.7%), grow headcount from 12 to 14 FTE, and implement geographic expansion to EU. Strong unit economics and runway support sustained investment.

allocation_section.narrative: Budget increase of $20K/month supports 2 critical hires (data architect and sales engineer) and data warehouse scaling. Headcount growth from 12 to 14 is modest relative to traction and runway. Budget phased over 4 weeks to allow hiring ramp.

milestones_section.success_criteria: Support 50% user growth without performance degradation

venture_narratives.name: MediLink Connect

health_section.narrative: MediLink demonstrates exceptional growth momentum with 35% MoM user acquisition and strong unit economics (CAC/LTV 0.135). Customer feedback positive (NPS 58). However, health score is held below scale threshold due to team gaps (3 key hires open, only 8 FTE total) and significant regulatory compliance requirements (HIPAA, data privacy). Team is adequate but stretched; regulatory risk is material but addressable.

decision_section.rationale: Exceptional traction growth justifies continued investment, but compliance gaps and team constraints prevent scale decision. Recommend focused iteration: (1) Fill compliance engineering lead role, (2) Build regulatory roadmap, (3) Validate healthcare customer fit, (4) Re-evaluate in 6 weeks with path to scale. If compliance risks are resolved and team is strengthened, scale decision likely in next cycle.

allocation_section.narrative: Budget increase of $10K/month supports hiring 2 critical roles: compliance engineering lead (essential for regulatory pathway) and full-stack engineer (product execution). Increase is modest due to 14-month runway (6-12 month band allows 10% increases max per policy).

risks_section: Regulatory compliance requirements may delay growth trajectory
Team constraints in compliance expertise require immediate hiring
Healthcare sales cycles longer - verify CAC sustainability as market matures

venture_narratives.name: TruckRoute Pro

health_section.narrative: TruckRoute Pro is underperforming across all dimensions. 32 weeks post-launch with minimal traction (5% MoM growth, 3% conversion rate), poor unit economics (CAC $2,800 vs LTV $3,600, ratio 0.778), and declining team health. Health score trending down. Burn rate ($75K/month) is unsustainable relative to revenue ($2K/month). Runway of 8 months is critical. Core GTM hypothesis (logistics software) appears unproven after sufficient market exposure.

decision_section.rationale: TruckRoute Pro meets multiple kill criteria: (1) CAC/LTV ratio 0.778 exceeds 2x LTV threshold with no trajectory improvement, (2) minimal traction at week 32 (5% MoM growth, 3% conversion), (3) unsustainable burn rate ($75K monthly against $2K revenue). Recommended action: Execute orderly wind-down over 6 weeks. Extract learning from supply chain vertical experience. Preserve team relationships for potential future ventures.

allocation_section.narrative: Budget reduction from $75K to $20K/month (runtime-only budget) pending final kill decision approval. Headcount reduced to minimal operational team (founder + 2 engineers) to maintain option for pivot if approved by leadership. Expect final wind-down to complete by end of May.

milestones_section.success_criteria: Kill postmortem completed, key learnings documented
All customers notified, migration plan for active users

risks_section: Team morale impact from kill decision - proactive communication essential
Shared infrastructure with Supply Forecast AI (v-004) requires careful migration
Ensure wind-down doesn't disrupt other ventures or damage team morale across portfolio

success_factors: Strong product-market fit evidenced by CAC/LTV ratio <0.2
Consistent growth trajectory (15%+ MoM monthly growth)
Efficient team execution relative to traction

Burn rate: Portfolio net burn $278K/month against $67K revenue; dependent on continuous fundraising
Codependency: eng-lead-001 shared between 2 ventures creates single point of failure

glossary.health_score: Composite 0-100 score assessing venture across traction, financial, team, and market dimensions
glossary.traction_score: 0-100 score focused on user acquisition, growth rate, and revenue momentum
glossary.CAC: Customer Acquisition Cost - average cost to acquire one customer
glossary.LTV: Lifetime Value - total profit expected from one customer over their lifetime
glossary.CAC/LTV Ratio: Efficiency metric; ideal <0.3 (customer worth 3x+ acquisition cost)
glossary.Runway: Months of operations sustainable at current burn rate with available cash
